users_deletion_schedule_check.name: users_deletion_schedule_check
users_deletion_schedule_check.value: "users"."deletion_scheduled_at" is null or "users"."deletion_requested_at" is not null

users_deleted_at_check.name: users_deleted_at_check
users_deleted_at_check.value: "users"."deleted_at" is null or "users"."deletion_requested_at" is not null

auth_challenge_deliveries_queued_fields_.name: auth_challenge_deliveries_queued_fields_check
auth_challenge_deliveries_queued_fields_.value: "auth_challenge_deliveries"."status" <> 'queued' or ("auth_challenge_deliveries"."provider" is null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."provider_message_id" is null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."error_code" is null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."error_message" is null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."sent_at" is null)

auth_challenge_deliveries_sent_fields_ch.name: auth_challenge_deliveries_sent_fields_check
auth_challenge_deliveries_sent_fields_ch.value: "auth_challenge_deliveries"."status" <> 'sent' or ("auth_challenge_deliveries"."provider" is not null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."error_code" is null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."error_message" is null)

auth_challenge_deliveries_failed_fields_.name: auth_challenge_deliveries_failed_fields_check
auth_challenge_deliveries_failed_fields_.value: "auth_challenge_deliveries"."status" <> 'failed' or ("auth_challenge_deliveries"."provider" is not null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."error_code" is not null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."error_message" is not null and "auth_challenge_deliveries"."sent_at" is null)

auth_challenge_delivery_attempts_sent_fi.name: auth_challenge_delivery_attempts_sent_fields_check
auth_challenge_delivery_attempts_sent_fi.value: "auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'sent' or ("auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."error_code" is null and "auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."error_message" is null)

auth_challenge_delivery_attempts_failed_.name: auth_challenge_delivery_attempts_failed_fields_check
auth_challenge_delivery_attempts_failed_.value: "auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'failed' or ("auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."error_code" is not null and "auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."error_message" is not null and "auth_challenge_delivery_attempts"."provider_message_id" is null)

calculation_participants_source_client_c.name: calculation_participants_source_client_check
calculation_participants_source_client_c.value: ("calculation_participants"."source" = 'crm_client' and "calculation_participants"."client_id" is not null) or ("calculation_participants"."source" = 'manual' and "calculation_participants"."client_id" is null)

client_join_intents_claimed_consistency_.name: client_join_intents_claimed_consistency_check
client_join_intents_claimed_consistency_.value: ("client_join_intents"."status" = 'claimed') = ("client_join_intents"."claimed_by_client_user_id" is not null and "client_join_intents"."claimed_at" is not null)

schedule_reservations_source_check.name: schedule_reservations_source_check
schedule_reservations_source_check.value: ("schedule_reservations"."kind" in ('booking', 'manual_block') and "schedule_reservations"."source_aggregate_id" is not null) or "schedule_reservations"."kind" = 'hold'

schedule_reservations_hold_expiry_check.name: schedule_reservations_hold_expiry_check
schedule_reservations_hold_expiry_check.value: ("schedule_reservations"."kind" = 'hold' and "schedule_reservations"."hold_expires_at" is not null) or ("schedule_reservations"."kind" <> 'hold' and "schedule_reservations"."hold_expires_at" is null)

messages_inbound_provider_dedupe_unique.name: messages_inbound_provider_dedupe_unique
messages_inbound_provider_dedupe_unique.where: "messages"."provider_message_id" is not null and "messages"."external_identity_id" is not null
